Fact: energy_methodology
What to find: Methodology used to measure or estimate training energy.
Card sections that often contain it: Environmental Impact, Energy, Carbon

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Training time is the total GPU time required for training each model, and power consumption is the peak power capacity per GPU device used, adjusted for power usage efficiency; the methodology is detailed in the linked paper (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2204.05149).
quotes: Training time is the total GPU time required for training each model and power consumption is the peak power capacity per GPU device used, adjusted for power usage efficiency.
The methodology used to determine training energy use and greenhouse gas emissions can be found here (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2204.05149).
